items.name: Neuro Desktop
items.description: Windows control integration for Neuro and Evil
launch_hints: Run neuro-desktop.exe from the bundled dist folder
Set NEURO_PERMISSIONS_FILE to a restrictive policy in production

items.name: Neuro Relay
items.description: Multiplexing relay for multiple integrations and games
launch_hints: Set NEURO_RELAY_ENABLED=true to route integrations through relay

items.name: ND Vision Server
items.description: Experimental model inference server for visual understanding
launch_hints: Run as an external process and expose HTTP endpoint before ND startup

items.name: MCP Bridge
items.description: Model Context Protocol bridge plugin for external tool servers
launch_hints: Install from the Extensions page or use install_extension action
Set NEURO_EXTENSION_INSTALL_MODE=git_clone to clone plugin repositories
